name: Invest App
summary: Mobile investing app: deal pools, deal and company pages, portfolio with payout schedules, top-up and invest drawers, onboarding chat and an AI assistant that answers with charts, deal cards and actions.
useWhen: Starting a mobile-first fintech or investing product with a portfolio, a catalogue of offers and payouts
An app that needs an AI assistant answering inside the product with charts, cards and confirmable actions
avoidWhen: Desktop dashboards: the layout is a single phone-width column with a bottom tab bar
Products without money flows: most screens assume balances, investments and payouts
stack: Django + Postgres API with LLM and MCP agent in server/
source: A hackathon investor app; brand, logos and data replaced with neutral samples
